summary: thiscall destructor over an array of 26 singly-linked lists. For each bucket this[0..25] it walks the list head, and per node: reads the next pointer from node index 6 (byte offset 24), runs sub_49A270 on the node as per-node cleanup, then frees the node with FreeWrapper_7bcf. Each bucket pointer is zeroed once its list is drained. Returns the result of the last FreeWrapper_7bcf call. Invoked once from sub_495300 (00495300).

local_names.j: current node in the linked list walk
local_names.v4: node being cleaned and freed in the current iteration
local_names.result: return value of the most recent FreeWrapper_7bcf call

operations.description: Outer loop over 26 buckets this[0]..this[25]; each bucket is processed and then zeroed
Inner loop walks the list from the bucket head; the next node is read from node index 6 (byte offset 24) before the current node is cleaned and freed
sub_49A270 invoked on each node as per-node teardown before the node is freed
FreeWrapper_7bcf invoked on each node to release its memory; its result becomes the loop value of result
Bucket head this[i] is set to 0 after its list has been fully drained
Returns the value of result, i.e. the last FreeWrapper_7bcf result, after all buckets are drained
Invoked by sub_495300 (00495300) as a teardown step
